Laboratory findings are significant for elevated serum levels of bilirubin, aminotransferases, alkaline phosphatase (ALP), γ-glutamyl transpeptidase (GGTP), immunoglobulins, as well as cholesterol (especially HDL fraction). Antiviral antibodies are not present. The erythrocyte sedimentation rate is also elevated. Anti-mitochondrial antibodies are found. A liver biopsy is performed, and the histopathologic examination shows bile duct injury, cholestasis, and granuloma formation. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis in this patient?
prompt_context: Options: A) Primary biliary cirrhosis B) Hemolytic anemia C) Hepatitis A D) Gilbert syndrome
